name: i2c_twoboards_comdma
description: I2C_TwoBoards_ComDMA on two NUCLEO-F446RE wired as its readme draws them (two_boards.json): as ComPolling, by DMA (HAL_I2C_*_DMA, DMA1 streams on I2C1's requests): I2C1 at 400 kHz, the slave's 10-bit address 0x30F, B1's USER button starting each step. The master sends its 150-byte buffer (SCL clocks 152 bytes: 2738 edges with START and STOP), then reads it back (153 bytes with the repeated START: 2758 edges). Both boards' buffers then hold the text and LD2 stays on on both.
